QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] Fixing the Floral Flute 2
QuestInfo.0: The Floral Flute looked to be revitalized by the offered lifeforce, but returned to its withered state. Maybe you need more? Speak with the Small Spirit.
QuestInfo.1:
You agreed to harvest more lifeforce for the Floral Flute. Gather #r100#k of each of the following items: #b#i4036101:# #t4036101:##k, #b#i4036102:# #t4036102:##k, and #b#i4036103:# #t4036103:##k. You can get them from #r#o8644000##k, #r#o8644001##k, and #r#o8644002##k monsters.

Return to the #rSmall Spirit#k in #b#m450005100##k after you've gathered the materials.
QuestInfo.2: The Floral Flute looked to be revitalized by the offered lifeforce, but returned to its withered state. Perhaps it is beyond saving.

0.0: Maybe the Songbloom needs more life force... I'm sorry, but please collect the essences of more wild spirits!

no.0: (Sniffs) Do you want the forest to die?

1.0: You brought the essences! I'll slop them on the Floral Flute. This is going to work, right? It just has to!

0.msg: #b(The Floral Flute appeared briefly revitalized, but quickly returned to its withered state.)#k

3.msg: What if... the Floral Flute can never be revived?\r\n(Sniffs) Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!

4.msg: #b(As the Small Spirit wails, the Wind Spirit flutters in on a breeze.)#k

5.msg: I heard your cry on the wind, and wooshed over. What is the matter? Will the flute still not toot?

default.0: We're gonna need a lot more essences. #r100#k of each of the following should do: #b#i4036101:# #t4036101:##k, #b#i4036102:# #t4036102:##k, and #b#i4036103:# #t4036103:##k. You can get them from #r#o8644000##k, #r#o8644001##k, and #r#o8644002##k monsters, just like before.
